entries.3560cc5a96b212d9: This business manufactures and sells ham and sausages, processed foods, marine products and dairy products in Japan and overseas. In Japan, the company, Nippon Ham Factory Co., Ltd., Minami Nippon Ham Co., Ltd., Nippon Ham Foods Co., Ltd., Nippon Ham Sozai Co., Ltd. and others manufacture them, and the company, Nippon Ham Marketing Co., Ltd. and others sell them. Hoko Co., Ltd. and Nippon Luna Co., Ltd. handle marine products and dairy products. Overseas, Day-Lee Foods, Inc., Thai Nippon Foods Co., Ltd. and others manufacture and sell ham, sausages, processed foods and meat. In April 2025, the Overseas Business Division was abolished, and the overseas processing subsidiaries were transferred to this segment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥448,366 million; revenue including internal revenue between segments was ¥530,339 million, a 0.6% decrease from the previous year. Manufacturing volume rose at the LJD Holdings group in North America, acquired in the previous fiscal year, but in the first half, sales volumes of various products other than Shauessen and the chilled bakery group declined, which had an impact.
entries.377e3d19598d3bfd: This business produces and sells meat, such as pork, chicken and beef, in Japan and overseas. In Japan, Nippon White Farm Co., Ltd. and Nippon Clean Farm Co., Ltd. raise pigs and broilers, Nippon Food Packer Co., Ltd. and others process them, and they are sold through the company and sales subsidiaries nationwide. Overseas, NH Foods Australia Pty. Ltd., Whyalla Beef Pty. Ltd. and others produce and sell meat. In April 2025, the Overseas Business Division was abolished, and the overseas meat subsidiaries were transferred to this segment. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥979,609 million, the largest among the reportable segments; revenue including internal revenue between segments was ¥1,034,133 million, an 8.1% increase from the previous year. The increase in revenue was due to improved sales conditions and higher sales volumes for domestic chicken and Australian beef, in addition to progress in passing on prices in the sales division.

entries.89af391572052bbd: This business organizes professional baseball games, operates the ballpark centered on “Hokkaido Ballpark F Village” in Kitahiroshima, Hokkaido, and oversees its overall management. It is made up of Hokkaido Nippon-Ham Fighters Co., Ltd., Fighters Sports & Entertainment Co., Ltd. and others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥27,785 million; revenue including internal revenue between segments was ¥31,027 million, a 15.0% increase from the previous year. Team performance was strong and attendance reached a record high, and events held in the off-season brought ballpark visitors to 4.66 million, increasing revenue from tickets, merchandise, and food and beverages. In April 2026, the “Sports & Entertainment Business Division” was newly established, and this business came under its umbrella.
